# MDFN

> Markdown-native authoring with source preservation, safe rendering, and collaboration.

## Documentation

- [Collaboration](/docs/collaboration) — Exchange authorized Yjs updates and compact exact batches.
- [Extensions and profiles](/docs/extensions) — Resolve syntax ownership, conflicts, and migrations.
- [Framework editors](/docs/framework-editors) — Install and mount a controller in React, Svelte, Solid, or the vanilla DOM.
- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started) — Install MDFN, edit Markdown, observe changes, and release the controller.
- [MDFN](/docs) — Markdown-native authoring with a durable source contract.
- [Integrations](/docs/integrations) — Connect assets, search, content, and AI through explicit bridges.
